instructions.concise: Give only the final numerical answer, without explanation.
instructions.explained: Explain your solution step by step, then state the final numerical answer clearly.

scope: Eight exposed GSM8K questions, each with original and one instruction-prefixed user prompt. Two families by two styles, four GPU lanes. AR/native/relay512 controls paired within each worker, greedy2048cap. No system-role modification, new training or independent16-question sample. Report output length and acceptance alongside time because concise answers change amortization. Every lane540seconds.
analysis: All192 outputs retained. Cluster each original problem with its instruction variant, paired methods. Descriptive throughput, native retention, progress/cycle, answer counts, caps and output lengths per condition. No prompt-independent or quality NI claim.
